# ktiler

> ktiler is a free, open-source KWin script that automatically tiles windows on KDE Plasma.

The desktop script requires KDE Plasma 6.3 or newer in a Wayland session.
Plasma 5 and X11 are not supported. ktiler supports per-display layouts,
shared-edge resizing, and customizable shortcuts to focus, swap, and move
windows across displays. The browser simulator requires no installation
and does not change your desktop.

## Get started

- [Install ktiler](https://ktiler.org/#install): Terminal and System Settings installation options.
- [Check compatibility](https://ktiler.org/help/#compatibility): Supported setups and how to check your Plasma version and session type.
- [Read the help guide](https://ktiler.org/help/): Setup, keyboard shortcuts, layouts, resizing, and how to pause or disable tiling.
- [Try the browser simulator](https://ktiler.org/simulator/): Practice tiling and moving windows without installing ktiler.

## Source and support

- [Source code](https://github.com/jars/ktiler): Project source and development documentation.
- [Report an issue](https://github.com/jars/ktiler/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.
- [MIT license](https://ktiler.org/LICENSE.md): Project software license.
